name: it-pros-wordaday
description: Start, stop, and restart both the Next.js UI and Go backend

scripts.start: npm run start:service & npm run start:portal & echo 'Both services started. Use npm run stop to shut down.'
scripts.stop: lsof -ti :3000 -ti :8080 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped portal (3000) and service (8080).'
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
